basic_info.description: 275 Romain Street blends panoramic Downtown and San Francisco Bay views with meticulous upgrades and modern convenience. This 3BD/2BA home + office features spacious living and dining areas, two fireplaces, and a chef's kitchen with Thermador appliances, LG refrigerator, and a wall of premium folding glass doors that open completely to a stylish Trex deck and landscaped backyard, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor entertaining experience. The primary suite includes a custom walk-in closet and heated en-suite bathroom floors. Smart home wiring, upgraded electrical, solar panels, and two EV chargers enhance efficiency. Additional updates include Marvin windows, a newer roof, and a rebuilt rear exterior. This home is move-in ready in a prime San Francisco location.
